title: Predictive Network Fault Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Counter drift against peers
blueprintSignals.definition: z-score of error and retransmit counters versus similar elements
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Peer groups must exclude the failing element

blueprintSignals.name: Temperature and power trend
blueprintSignals.definition: slope of temperature and supply voltage over 7 days

blueprintSignals.name: Software version and recent restart count
blueprintSignals.definition: version and number of resets in 30 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Version must be as at prediction time

label: For "Predictive Network Fault Detection": Predict element failures and severe degradations hours to days ahead from performance counters and logs so engineers can intervene before customers are affected. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Random split across time.
